spec.design: Blocked-copying counterpart of legacy_reserve_frontier.json. The pipelines, reserve grid, cliff probes and windows are frozen exactly as in the non-blocking study (chosen there as the best shared-seat daily-maximum pipelines), so only the copying rule differs. Daily maximum withdrawals, persistent demand, shared seat reservation, first-check activation or pass forfeiture. Frozen product-specific pipelines from prior shared-seat daily-maximum results. Every window starts empty with fresh owner funding. Post-startup deaths means all deaths after 365 elapsed days, including young replacements. All overlapping historical windows remain in-sample; none is a holdout. Full-tape cents around 6780.10 diagnose the known March 2026 event, not a recommended precision of reserve selection.

legacy_25k.description: Headline. Every Apex payout rule switched on, and our own behaviour is to request $500 -- the firm's minimum -- from each account every calendar month, carrying unpayable months as a backlog.

legacy_50k.description: Legacy 50K under inherited payout interpretation; user-specified $250 seat cost; see research/legacy_50k/SOURCES.md

evaluation_spec.note: Blocked-copying counterpart of legacy_eval_supply.json: identical evaluations, grid, shelves and refinement rule; each funded account copies a signal only while flat. The unlimited-supply winners come from the blocked reserve comparison and must reproduce, including per-trade account assignments. Evaluations do not depend on funded-account copying, so the EODMAE reconciliation must equal the non-blocking one. Settings shared with the 25K blocked-pipeline study must reproduce it exactly.
